items.en_title: Jeriquara (SP) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #003
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Jeriquara (SP) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 497,907; proposals close Nov 19, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
